name: Badminton Training Simulator (BTS)
summary: Badminton Training Simulator (BTS) features relatively rigorous physics, authentic and satisfying feel, balancing practicality and entertainment. It supports AI battles and multiplayer matches. Fun mini-games include landing challenge, net challenge, target challenge, smash target challenge, and self-training. If your skills are superb, every leaderboard is an opportunity for you to pursue the top spot. You can also look for Easter eggs in the venue, and even experience the fun of free falling and badminton
